Danish

Etymology 1

Formally a passive of syne. Compare Old West Norse sýnask (“appear”), Norwegian Nynorsk synast, Swedish synas.

Pronunciation

  • IPA(key): /synəs/, [ˈsynəs], [ˈsynn̩s], [ˈsys]
  • Homophone: syntes

Verb

synes (past syntes, perfect har syntes)

  1. to think (with an object or a subordinate clause)
  2. to seem, appear (with an infinitive)
  3. to look (with an adjective)
  4. to like (with the preposition om), see synes om

Norwegian Bokmål

Etymology

From Old Norse sýnast. See also English seem.

Pronunciation

  • Audio:(file)

Verb

synes (imperative synes, present tense synes or syns, simple past and past participle syntes)

  1. to appear, seem
  2. to think (be of the opinion that)
  3. synes synd på - to be / feel sorry for
